text: Wee one is 21 month, got chickenpox, spots are dead itchy and hes scratchin at them but otherwise hes fine. Bit of a cough too, nothin much. Neck's fine, he can look doon at his toes nae bother, and hes wide awake, blethering away at the telly. Just want a straight answer - is there anythin I can put on the spots to stop the itch or dae I just leave it. Dinnae want a lecture, just tell me whats safe for his age
